chars.GHAFOUR: GHAFOUR: a young man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and dark grey jogging pants, barefoot.
chars.WIFE: WIFE (his brother's wife): a woman wearing a long-sleeved lilac satin pajama set and a pink headband, fluffy white slippers.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night, a small upstairs bedroom in a Moroccan house in Tangier lit by a warm bedside lamp. GHAFOUR sits up on a single bed, eyes wide, frozen in shock, clutching his phone to his chest. WIFE stands in the half-open doorway leaning on the frame with a sly smile. Awkward comic tension between the two.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Night, dim upstairs hallway of a Moroccan house with zellige tiles and a carved wooden door. GHAFOUR has just opened his bedroom door and peeks out, startled. WIFE stands right next to the door in the hallway, caught, surprised hand on her chest. Both stare at each other.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Night, upstairs hallway of a Moroccan house. WIFE tilts her head and asks GHAFOUR something innocently with an open palm; GHAFOUR scratches the back of his head nervously, looking suspicious and confused.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Night, small bedroom with a single bed, a Moroccan blanket and a window showing city lights of Tangier. WIFE steps into the room through the door uninvited, smiling. GHAFOUR, sitting on the bed, leans back away from her with an alarmed face.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Night, small bedroom. Close-ish medium shot: GHAFOUR on the bed sweating, big sweat drops flying, eyes darting sideways, very uncomfortable. In the background WIFE leans on the wardrobe, relaxed, chatting and smiling.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Night, small bedroom. GHAFOUR stands by the bed holding both hands up politely like saying 'please, I am just a guest here', polite forced smile. WIFE stands in the middle of the room, arms crossed, amused.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Night, small bedroom. Comic moment: GHAFOUR sits on the bed pulling the blanket up to his neck like a shy person, embarrassed blushing face. WIFE laughs, covering her mouth with her hand, standing near the bed.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Night, small bedroom lit by a bedside lamp. WIFE has sat down on the edge of GHAFOUR's bed close to him, turned toward him, chatting comfortably. GHAFOUR sits stiff as a statue at the far end of the bed, eyes huge, staring at the door, terrified someone will come up the stairs.
